notes.title: German language fix
notes.content:
Well, more or less the title says it all.
The problem with incorrect order of words in German language is solved.
We're sorry for any trouble that it might've caused.
If you find any bugs or rough patches like this one - pls, mention them in the forum.
Thanks a lot for your input, means a world to us.

notes.title: 1st update!
notes.content:
You probably wouldn't even notice this, but we did some minor changes and tweaks.
Thanx for the feedback, by the way! Some of it was included in this fix too.

notes.title: Ashland Dossier has just been released!
notes.content:
We're glad to announce the release of Ashland Dossier.
It's really good news to both us and, hopefully, you too )
Please if at all possible, try to leave any feedback that you think might be helpful to us and other players too.
Thank you for your long-time support. It means a lot to the team.
We do sincerely hope that you'll like the game and the idea behind it.

And also, please stay safe and sound.

PsyRob team.

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.content:
Everything is in place now. The game is ready to be out in less than two weeks. 
We can't wait for you to play it, hunt every damn Nazi down and make them pay.
Also please make sure to try the demo in case you haven't already. 
Any feedback is greatly welcome. Every opinion matters. Every suggestion counts.

So please stay tuned for upcoming release and we do hope that you'll like Ashland Dossier as much as we do.

notes.title: Upcoming Release
notes.content:
The good news is that the game is totally ready to be released on Steam. Basically, it's approved and all, and it's just one click away to appear in store.
But the plan is to release Ashland Dossier on all platforms (consoles in that case) simultaneously.
Now, 2 of 3 certifications are already done, with the last one still pending. As soon as it's settled, the game will be out. 
Our understanding is that it won't take too long. So, we're just around the corner with release.
We're in the final stretch, so it's just a matter of time now.
Hopefully, you'll like the game and all the waiting was surely worth it.

Thank you for your support, and please stay safe.

notes.title: Spanish language added!
notes.content:
Ashland Dossier has four languages now. We might add a few more after release, though.
Some minor touches are still left to be done, but other than that the game is basically ready.
We will announce the release date soon enough.
Thank you for your support. It means a lot to us!

All the best wishes in the coming year, Hopefully, everything turns out to be fine for everybody.
So, please stay tuned for future updates, and let's stay safe, all of us.

notes.title: GERMAN LANGUAGE ADDED!
notes.content:
Well, the German language is here. Another one to come for certain will be Spanish.
Also, this updated Demo clarifies some aspects and hopefully eliminates any confusion that you, players, have talked about before.
Feel free to replay it, even if you already gave it a spin sometime before. It's always a good thing to refresh old memories. 

Secondly, the release is almost around the corner, so please stay tuned for later updates.

notes.title: Demo updated!
notes.content:
We're getting to the end of the production cycle, so while going from prototype to real project, it's only wise to be updating the demo too.
It won't have any radical changes as the course is already set, but we've added some small but important features. Not all of them, of course, are seen to a player's eye, however, everything is getting into its proper place.
All this being said, it's time to test this updated demo and wishlist the game in case you haven't already )

Please stay safe and tuned for another update that is coming really soon.

notes.title: Demo out NOW!
notes.content:
This is one big event for us!
As the whole game is scheduled for release later this year, today we are proud to present our Demo version.
So, please take it for a spin and tell us what you think about it. Any feedback is gladly welcomed. We definitely appreciate every opinion and every voice matters here.

Please stay tuned for new updates that are coming really soon.

notes.title: Huge News!
notes.content:
Long time no chat, people, but we're back on track. 
No matter how bad the last 18 months were for any of us, still, it's time to move on and proceed with our plans,
As some of you might've noticed, we kind of revamped the game in terms of setting and mechanics too.
The great news also is that the Demo is waiting to be approved by Steam and as soon as they do, we'll publish it immediately. Of course, it's a bit on the alpha side, but it should give you an overall feeling of what it is and what to expect later.

We plan to release Ashland Dossier later this year, probably in Q4.

Having said that, we're hoping that Steam will approve the demo soon and we can't wait for you try it out.
Please stay safe, and stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Another mini game
notes.content:
At this particular point we have to compare two photos of our suspect.

First one dates back to the WWII period and the second one was taken in the present time. To make sure that we are on the right track, we got to point out any distinctive similarities between thes two persons. 

That is how we confirm the suspect's identity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101081/8a81a981dda93c7c7d059064e76c6d054894b398.gif[/img]

This activity is only one of the dozens ahead of us. To find and take the Nazi down, agents have to be ready to do some solid and scrupulous work. It's not easy, and sometimes even dangerous, but in the end it helps restore justice. No task is too small in this line of work.

Please stay tuned for more updates that are coming really soon.

notes.title: The camp
notes.content:
Concentration camps at the time dreaded every nation by even a mere mentioning. 
Some people did have hope of leaving this soul-devouring abyss, but for most camp was usually a one-way street.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101081/060f0c689df8b04d092d131f8a10c7b55cfc4884.gif[/img]

Inmates were constantly tortured, beaten, famished, humiliated, and of course directly killed.
One of the most unbearable activities, including back-breaking labor, was roll-calls.
For hours poor inmates had to stand under the sizzling sun or pouring rain waiting for their numbers to be checked by an officer.
People often fainted and even died, especially during extremely long roll-calls done, for instance, when an escape occured. One or even two days spent standing straight up, without any food or water, can break even the toughest will.

This is why those responsible for such terrible deeds must be caught and brought to justice.

Please stay tuned for more updates. They are coming very soon.

notes.title: Office work
notes.content:
Hunting down Nazis always begins with gathering proof of their evil deeds. Once it's known what exact crimes each of them has committed, task team gets ready for deployment.

However, before that, office has to establish suspect's location first. And only then the operation is green-lit. As you see, it is a very elaborate chain of analysis, but in the end it should prove worthy of effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101081/8143594d7cf95ead25f21f5e9020af0964773c86.gif[/img]

Please stay tuned for more updates that are coming very soon.

notes.title: A puzzle
notes.content:
Evidence plays crucial role in Ashland Dossier as it greatly helps to sentence Nazis for bigger terms. And that is our main objective here. Obviously, life is, the largest sentence, but to convince the court we must first gather all the possible evidence.

Here is one of the ways to do it. In this particular case we must open the drawer that has a code-lock. Can you crack the code?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101081/b08f877142a2136df7d3f59dd6c9c531a6ad89bc.gif[/img]

Please stay tuned for more updates that are coming very soon.

notes.title: Idle animation test
notes.content:
While playing during the 40's timeline, player assumes control over one of the surviving witnesses (a good guy). That's how we tested the speed and scaling too. 

[previewyoutube=Ra1Rke9m-ps;full][/previewyoutube]

We are planning to have over a dozen characters (both PCs and NPCs) that at the time inhabited the camp. Unfortunately, most of them were quite unfriendly, to say the least. 
But it is exactly our job to catch the meanest and bring them down.

Please stay tuned for more updates that are coming very soon. Hopefully, early next year we'll show you what we've been working on for a long time now.

May 2020 be the year of peace and goodwill.

notes.title: Previous title art
notes.content:
I gotta convey this idea that we had going around before Ashland Dossier emerged.
Previously this game was called Ashland and it was going to be a manager/survival kind of experience. You were supposed to survive inside the concentration camp for a certain amount of turns. 

However, having received some helpful feedback we decided to change the original idea. We thought it'd be better to introduce some characters and add some other mechanics (like detective work and spy hunts). This way Ashland Dossier will bring in a better dynamic as well as emotionally involve player on a different level.

I mean, the camp is still there, but now it has more sense to it in this new light of taking down damn Nazis. Hopefully, we're on the right track here. Stay tuned for more stuff which is coming soon enough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101081/775b814665b09ed2c42021adcf0b9940d66ee6b2.png[/img]
